jobs.title: AI Engineer - Agentic
jobs.why: Exceptional fit for candidate's exact experience in agentic workflows, RAG, guardrails, and LLM evaluation.

jd.text:
Master Works is looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to join our growing team and design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems that can plan, reason, and act. The role covers both single-agent and multi-agent systems, as well as orchestration of workflows involving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context engineering, reasoning, tool calling, memory, and inter-agent communication. This role is ideal for a strong software engineer with hands-on AI/ML development experience and a passion for transforming generative AI models into reliable, goal-driven systems capable of solving complex, real-world business problems.

Key Responsibilities:

• Architect, build, and deploy agentic AI systems that integrate AI agents with foundation models, enterprise systems, third-party tools, and APIs using established agentic frameworks or custom-built orchestrators.
• Build and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory, and reasoning pipelines that ground agent decisions in reliable, real-world data and enable persistent, contextual, and adaptive behavior.
• Design single-agent and multi-agent workflows, including planning, delegation, tool selection, handoffs, inter-agent communication, and human-in-the-loop controls.
• Optimize orchestration and reasoning performance while balancing autonomy, latency, cost, interpretability, reliability, and maintainability.
• Collaborate with Generative AI engineers, application engineers, MLOps engineers, and product teams to move agentic AI solutions from prototype to production.
• Monitor, evaluate, and benchmark agent performance, and help ensure AI systems are safe, accurate, trustworthy, observable, and capable of delivering a high-quality user experience.
• Document agent architectures, communication flows, guardrails, context-engineering strategies, memory design, tool interfaces, and orchestration logic to ensure clarity and reproducibility.
• Stay current with advances in agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, model-context protocols, cognitive architectures, evaluation methods, and AI safety mechanisms.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver complete AI solutions for customers.

Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• 2+ years of hands-on experience developing agentic AI systems, LLM-powered applications, or advanced Generative AI solutions.
• Preferably 5+ years of overall professional software engineering experience
• Contributions to open-source agentic AI frameworks, orchestration platforms, evaluation tooling, or agent communication protocols.
• Experience building microservices and deploying AI applications on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Experience with AI safety, guardrails, observability, traceability, evaluation, and explainability for agentic AI systems.
• Experience deploying LLM or agentic workloads in production using containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and modern MLOps or LLMOps practices.

Job Location: HQ

jobs.title: AI Performance Engineer (Competitive & Network Analysis) - Riyadh, KSA
jobs.why: Focuses on low-level hardware inference optimization, compilers, and firmware rather than software AI application engineering.

jd.text:
Company

Qualcomm Middle East Information Technology Company LLC

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary

About us

Qualcomm is growing its presence in Riyadh and is hiring Data Centre Engineers to support our expanding infrastructure across the region.

As Saudi Arabia accelerates its digital transformation under Vision 2030, Qualcomm is investing in world‑class computing and data centre capabilities to power AI, cloud, and advanced connectivity at scale. This is a unique opportunity to work in a fast‑growing technology hub, supporting critical environments and helping shape the future of data centre operations in the Kingdom and beyond.

Qualcomm is utilizing its traditional strengths in digital wireless technologies to play a central role in the evolution of Cloud AI. We are investing in several supporting technologies including Deep Learning. The Qualcomm Cloud AI team is developing hardware and software solutions for Inference Acceleration. 

We are hiring an AI Performance Engineers at multiple levels to join our dynamic, collaborative team.

This role spans the full product lifecycle—from cutting-edge research and development to commercial deployment—and demands strategic thinking, strong execution, and excellent communication skills.

This Role Involves The Following Activities

• Convert, optimize and deploy models for efficient inference using PyTorch, ONNX.
• Work at the forefront of GenAI by understanding advanced algorithms (e.g. attention mechanisms, MoEs) and numerics to identify new optimization opportunities.
• Performance analysis and optimization of LLM, VLM, and diffusion models for inference.  Scale performance for throughput and latency constraints.
• Mapping the next generation AI workloads on top of current and future hardware designs.
• Work closely with customers to drive solutions by collaborating with internal compiler, firmware and platform teams.
• Analyze complex performance or stability issues to work towards final root cause of underlying problems.
• Create engineering solutions to deliver continuous insights into performance of AI workloads guiding the improvements over time.
• Design and implement high-level kernels, e.g. in Triton, with a focus on generating efficient, low-level code.

You Will Demonstrate The Following

• Hands-on experience in building and optimizing language models, notably in PyTorch, ONNX, preferably in production-grade environments.
• Deep understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms and performance trade-offs.
• Experience in workload mapping strategies exhibiting sharding or various parallelisms.
• Strong Python programming skills.
• Proactive learning about the latest inference optimization techniques.
• Understanding of computer architecture, ML accelerators, in-memory processing and distributed systems.
• Strong communication, problem-solving skills and ability to learn and work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
• MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.

Bonus Skills

• Background in neural network operators and mathematical operations, including linear algebra and math libraries.
• Understanding of machine learning compilers.
• Experience in converging accuracy and its evaluation methods.
• Knowledge of torch.compile or torchDynamo.
• PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Machine Learning

What's On Offer

Apart from working with great people, we offer the below:

• Salary including housing & transport allowance

• 16 weeks fully paid Maternity Leave
• 6 weeks fully paid Paternity Leave

• Child Education Allowance

Minimum Qualifications

jobs.title: Data Quality Engineer (Informatica CDQ)
jobs.why: Specialized Informatica CDQ enterprise data quality role; incompatible with candidate's modern Python/LLM stack.

jd.text:
Informatica IDMC Data Quality Engineer

We are looking for an Informatica IDMC Data Quality Engineer to implement, test, deploy, and stabilize data quality capabilities across a multi-wave enterprise data governance rollout.

Responsibilities

• Review approved CDE registers, DQ rule catalogs, business definitions, thresholds, and source-to-field mappings for each rollout wave

• Profile SAP-originated and other prioritized datasets landed in Azure Data Lake Storage; analyze completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, accuracy, and integrity

• Design and configure reusable Informatica Cloud Data Quality assets: rule specifications, mappings, dictionaries/reference data, scorecards, validation controls, and monitoring jobs

• Implement technical DQ rules mapped to CDEs and business rules; configure thresholds, pass/fail logic, alerts, exception capture, and rerun processes

• Establish exception handling and remediation workflows for failed records, with traceability to source data and responsible data owners/stewards

• Support integration of DQ rules and results with IDMC catalog, lineage, workflows, dashboards, data marketplace, and enterprise data portal

• Work with SAP SMEs to validate tables, fields, extraction logic, and interpretation of rule failures

• Create test plans, test cases, test data, execution evidence, defect logs, and traceability matrices; perform unit, system, integration, regression, UAT, and production validation

• Support deployment across dev, QA, UAT, and production, including release packaging, configuration migration, change records, go-live checks, and rollback readiness

• Monitor job runs and DQ scores, troubleshoot failures, optimize performance, and provide hypercare and stabilization support

• Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials

• Participate in sprint planning, estimation, daily ceremonies, demos, and status reporting

Requirements

• Strong hands-on experience with Informatica IDMC, especially Cloud Data Quality and Cloud Data Profiling

• Practical experience building rule specifications, mappings, dictionaries, reusable DQ assets, profiling tasks, scorecards, exception management, and monitoring processes

• Strong understanding of data quality dimensions, rule design, thresholds, root-cause analysis, remediation, and DQ KPIs

• Proficiency in SQL for profiling, reconciliation, source validation, test-data preparation, and defect analysis

• Experience with cloud data lakes and file-based ingestion, preferably Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and CSV landing patterns

• Experience integrating IDMC with relational databases, ERP systems, cloud platforms, catalog/metadata capabilities, and downstream reporting

• Working knowledge of data governance concepts: CDEs, business glossaries, stewardship, metadata, lineage, workflows, data marketplaces

• Experience with testing, release management, change control, production deployment, monitoring, and performance tuning

• 5+ years in data management, data engineering, or data quality, including 2–3 years hands-on Informatica cloud data quality implementation (preferred)

• Experience with SAP S/4HANA source data, SAP BODS extracts, or SAP-to-data-lake integration patterns (preferred)

• Informatica Cloud Data Quality Professional certification or equivalent IDMC training (desirable)

• Experience in energy, petrochemicals, manufacturing, or similarly regulated environments (advantage)

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Data Management, or related discipline

Job Types: Full-time, Temporary, Contract

Application Question(s):

• Describe a DQ implementation you delivered hands-on in Informatica IDMC Cloud Data Quality: what rules, scorecards, and exception processes did you build, and for how many tables/CDEs?

• What is your total relevant experience in years (data quality / data management, and specifically hands-on Informatica IDMC)?

• What type of iqama status (transferable, non-transferable, dependent, Premium Residency, Saudi/GCC national, etc.).

• What is your notice period / earliest joining date, and are you available to work onsite in Riyadh?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: QA Engineer / Software Tester
jobs.why: Manual QA/tester role; completely wrong function and seniority for a senior AI/software engineer.

jd.text:
Company Description Centro de Estudios en Derecho del Trabajo (CEDT) is an academic and research-focused institution dedicated to studying labor law and workplace practices. The organization collaborates with legal professionals, researchers, and institutions to promote knowledge, analysis, and innovation in labor-related matters. CEDT develops publications, digital resources, and educational initiatives that help improve understanding of employment regulations and workers’ rights. Team members contribute to projects that combine legal expertise with technology to make information more accessible and reliable for a broad audience.
Role Description This is a part-time, remote role for a QA Engineer / Software Tester at CEDT. The QA Engineer will design, execute, and document manual test cases to validate the functionality, usability, and reliability of web-based and internal applications used for labor law research and information dissemination. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing requirements, preparing test plans, performing test execution, identifying and documenting defects, and collaborating with developers and project stakeholders to ensure timely resolution. The role also involves contributing to quality assurance best practices, maintaining test documentation, and providing clear feedback to improve product quality and user experience.
Qualifications
• Candidates should possess strong skills in Test Execution and Software Testing to verify system behavior and uncover defects.
• Candidates should possess hands-on experience in Manual Testing and creating well-structured Test Cases to cover functional and non-functional requirements.
• Candidates should possess solid Quality Assurance skills to contribute to test planning, process improvement, and adherence to standards.
• Candidates should possess attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to document findings clearly and accurately.
• Candidates should possess familiarity with common bug-tracking tools and basic understanding of SDLC and agile methodologies.
• Candidates should possess effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
• A background in software engineering, information technology, or related field is beneficial; interest or experience in legal or academic environments is a plus.
